name_reason: Current name 'caller_context' misdescribes the contents. Both writers (fd2_init_movement_range_floodfill @ 0x4E047, fd2_pathfind_to_destination @ 0x4E1AD) store their FIRST argument here (MOV ESI,[EBP+8]; MOV [0x6006A],ESI). The sole caller fd2_player_action_menu_loop passes the return of fd2_get_movement_cost_table_for_job(class) for that argument, which = data_fd2_battle_movement_cost_table + class*0x14 (a 20-byte per-tile-type movement-cost row for the unit's job). The recursion preserves it in live ESI; the leaf neighbor steps (fd2_flood_fill_neighbor_step @ 0x4E188, fd2_pathfind_neighbor_step_with_tiebreak @ 0x4E34A) read it as the secondary cost-table base: SUB CL,[ESI+EAX] i.e. tile_cost = this_ptr[cost_idx]. So it holds a per-job movement-cost table pointer, not a caller context. Proposed name reflects the data type (pointer, _ptr suffix matching siblings data_fd2_battle_pathfind_tile_cost_table_ptr / _battle_tile_map_ptr / _path_output_buffer_ptr) and the domain (data_fd2_battle_pathfind_*). Distinct from the data array data_fd2_battle_movement_cost_table @ 0x61646. No address residue in either name. RECORD ONLY - rename applied in Stage 2 (touches globals.h + all references in pathfnd.c).
purpose: Pathfind state: pointer to the acting unit's per-job movement-cost table (the secondary cost table), used by the flood-fill / pathfinding leaf steps to look up per-tile-type movement cost.
logic_summary: Both pathfind orchestrators store their first argument here at entry as the first setup store (MOV ESI,[EBP+8]; MOV dword ptr [0x6006A],ESI at 0x4E047 and 0x4E1AD). That argument is the return value of fd2_get_movement_cost_table_for_job(class) = data_fd2_battle_movement_cost_table + class*0x14 (a 20-byte per-tile-type movement-cost row for the unit's job class; class can be overridden to 0x13 flying / 0x10 special unit). The recursive expansion (fd2_flood_fill_movement_range_recursive / fd2_pathfind_recursive_with_direction) never touches ESI, so the value is inherited through the live register and Ghidra records only the two writes with no direct read-xref. The leaf neighbor steps read it back as a base pointer: cost_idx = primary_attr_table[(attr & 0x3FF)*4 + 1] (primary table @ 0x60060), then tile_cost = this_ptr[cost_idx] (SUB CL,byte ptr [ESI+EAX]), and new_residual = remaining_mp - tile_cost.
datatype: uint32 (pointer; stored/used as a 32-bit address, points to uint8[20] per-job movement-cost row)
element_semantics: Single scalar holding a far/near pointer to a 20-byte uint8 array (one movement-cost byte per tile-type index 0..19) for the acting unit's job class; dereferenced as this_ptr[cost_idx] where cost_idx is the tile-type index fetched from the primary tile-attribute table at 0x60060.
comment_original_issue: Title line read 'caller-supplied secondary cost-table base / caller context @ 0x6006A', presenting 'caller context' as a co-equal interpretation; the body was mechanically accurate but the title perpetuated the misleading caller-context framing and omitted the concrete provenance (per-job row of data_fd2_battle_movement_cost_table via fd2_get_movement_cost_table_for_job).
notes: Evidence chain: leaf steps fd2_flood_fill_neighbor_step (0x4E188 SUB CL,[ESI+EAX]) and fd2_pathfind_neighbor_step_with_tiebreak (0x4E34A SUB CL,[ESI+EAX]) both consume this global (via ESI) as the secondary cost-table base. fd2_get_movement_cost_table_for_job @ 0x4E555 returns data_fd2_battle_movement_cost_table + job*0x14 (src/table/table.c:132). Caller fd2_player_action_menu_loop @ 0x18890 passes that pointer as arg1 to both orchestrators. Memory at 0x6006A is all-zero (BSS). Ghidra live symbol name confirmed = data_fd2_battle_pathfind_caller_context. Created a data PLATE_COMMENT at 0x6006A (was empty) and saved the program. Other comment blocks in pathfnd.c (lines ~147/338/554/648/760) reference this symbol by name and will be updated together with the Stage-2 rename; not touched here per single-symbol rule.
